verdicts.reason: None of the Santa Ana documents (D084, D085, DX18, DX19, DX06) mention security deposits. The retrieved passages cover rent stabilization, just cause eviction and the algorithmic rent-setting ban. No document says Santa Ana lacks a deposit rule or is barred from having one.

The retrieved screening-fee passages are Berkeley material (D005) and the state statute text (D026/DX08). Nothing addresses Santa Ana local law. No document says Santa Ana has no screening-fee rule, and state-law rules would not establish an absence of a rule.

DX07 discusses California-wide criminal-history and source-of-income screening rules, not Santa Ana local law. The Santa Ana documents do not address tenant screening restrictions, so there is no support for a finding of no rule.
